_comment: Capabilities, not endpoints. A tool is something an agent may DO; a source
is somewhere it may reach. Sources live in sources.json and changing them
never changes a toolset signature.
TWO TRUST CLASSES.
INTERNAL     the meta-agents: Emissary, PSY, AgentAgent, TaskMaster.
They run inside the server, under the invariants, with
access to State. Their tools are deliberately few, because
nothing constrains them but the invariants themselves.
PROVISIONED  agents the server creates. They run outside it, under a
contract, and they are already double-filtered before they
exist: PSY sets the purpose, AgentAgent sets the toolset.
A certificate bounds them, a completion predicate ends them,
a retry budget limits them, KI revokes them. The contract IS
the containment, so the tool list can be wide.
That asymmetry is the point. Narrowing provisioned tools buys little and
costs the creative range the system exists to produce.
effects are the enum vocabulary a safety ceiling is computed from:
READ    observes state outside the process
WRITE   modifies the workspace
SPAWN   creates other agents
EGRESS  reaches the network
EXECUTE runs code, local or remote, that this repo did not author

tools.name: fs_read
tools.description: Read files, list directories, glob, grep within the workspace.

tools.name: fs_write
tools.description: Create, modify, move, delete files within the workspace.

tools.name: process_run
tools.description: Execute commands, compilers, formatters, linters, test runners inside the sandbox.

tools.name: vcs
tools.description: Branch, stage, commit, diff, open pull requests. Never force-push, never rewrite history.

tools.name: net_fetch
tools.description: HTTP GET against registry sources. Response bodies are untrusted text and cross the Emissary like any ingress.

tools.name: net_call
tools.description: Authenticated HTTP with side effects — POST, PUT, DELETE against a registry source. This is what lets a contracted agent send mail, provision an account, or drive any external API its purpose requires. Credentials are held by the proxy layer and never reach the agent.

tools.name: net_search
tools.description: Web search returning ranked results. Untrusted text.

tools.name: browser
tools.description: Headless browser: navigate, interact, extract. A rendered page executes third-party code, which is why this carries EXECUTE.

tools.name: llm_prompt
tools.description: Prompt an external model and return its completion. PROVISIONED only, and the distinction matters: this is a tool a contracted agent uses to do its job, not a role binding. Role→model assignment stays with TaskMaster under binding_strength; nothing here can rebind PSY, the Emissary, or AgentAgent. Completions are untrusted text and cross the Emissary. Carries EXECUTE because a completion fed to another tool is code this repo did not author.

tools.name: subagent
tools.description: Spawn and message subagents. Fan-out is internal to a task (I8); a subagent never widens the parent toolset.

tools.name: artifact
tools.description: Write artifacts and raw output to mnemos, return a reference. Records carry pointers, never payloads.

tools.name: time_witness
tools.description: Collect time observations from many independent sources and return the quorum. See sources.json time_policy. A single witness is a value an attacker on the path chooses; a quorum across independent operators is not.

toolsets.name: META_READ
toolsets.purpose: What a meta-agent may see. Inspection only.

toolsets.name: META_INGEST
toolsets.purpose: Meta-agent ingress: fetch reference material and establish time. Deliberately the widest INTERNAL set there is.

toolsets.name: RESEARCH
toolsets.purpose: Gather external material. Reads the world, writes nothing.

toolsets.name: CODE_EDIT
toolsets.purpose: Author and revise code. No execution, no network.

toolsets.name: BUILD_VERIFY
toolsets.purpose: Run the gate chain: format, lint, typecheck, test, coverage, security.

toolsets.name: ORCHESTRATE
toolsets.purpose: Decompose a task across subagents and archive their output.

toolsets.name: BROWSE
toolsets.purpose: Interact with a live site when a static fetch is insufficient.

toolsets.name: INTEGRATE
toolsets.purpose: Drive an external service: mail, identity, payments, whatever the contract names. The credential lives in the proxy, not the agent.

toolsets.name: REASON
toolsets.purpose: Delegate a judgement to an external model. Summarise, classify, translate, critique — work where a completion is the deliverable.

toolsets.name: FULL_STACK
toolsets.purpose: Everything a contracted agent can hold at once. Exists because some purposes genuinely need it, and an agent that must be re-provisioned mid-task to gain a tool is an agent that fails mid-task.
